rv.q: Thanks to phenomenally well-sung gospel music, we do get the joy.
In all, “The Gospel At Colonus” is a truly awe-inspiring celebration of life.
Bless yourself and see this show.

Following the story of Oedipus, the man who pronounced, "I am Oedipus, the accursed," who leaves Thebes and travels to the town of Colonus, The Gospel of Colonus tells Oedipus's continuous story that features themes of forgiveness, death, war, and above all, love.
It is a fascinating adaptation of an exceedingly challenging story to tell that naturally plays into the customs and traditions of Black churches.
In keeping with God’s plan, this show is pure magic!

cn.t: Critics hail this jubilant gospel adaptation of Sophocles as wildly entertaining and spiritually uplifting, with infectious music that transforms Greek tragedy into a high-energy Pentecostal celebration that demands audience participation.
